# rancher Provider

Manage the [Rancher token secrets engine](https://github.com/IUCLabs/vault-plugin-secrets-rancher) (config, service accounts, and roles) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao. The plugin must already be registered in the server's plugin catalog.

Resources are prefixed `rancher_`, so declare the provider under the local name `rancher`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    # Resources are prefixed rancher_, so declare the provider under the local name "rancher".
    rancher = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-rancher"
    }
  }
}

# address and token fall back to VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN.
provider "rancher" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
